name: mcp.nerve.mattemena.com
description:
Matte Nerve connects Claude to advertising, analytics, CRM, and spreadsheet platforms so teams can manage marketing workflows using natural language.

The connector supports Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Snapchat Ads, Google Sheets, and HubSpot CRM. Users can analyze performance, inspect campaigns, create and update ad campaigns, manage ad groups and creatives, work with audiences and keywords, review budgets and bidding strategies, and generate reporting workflows directly from Claude.

Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 with PKCE. Users connect their Matte Nerve account once, then Claude can securely access only the tools and connected platforms authorized for that user.

This connector is designed for marketing teams, agencies, growth teams, media buyers, and analysts who want to operate cross-platform advertising workflows from Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add mcp.nerve.mattemena.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add mcp.nerve.mattemena.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.nerve.mattemena.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the mcp.nerve.mattemena.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: mcp.nerve.mattemena.com provides these MCP tools: checkConnectionsTool, getToolSchemasTool, multiExecuteTool, and searchToolsTool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to mcp.nerve.mattemena.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to mcp.nerve.mattemena.com in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
mcp.nerve.mattemena.com requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
mcp.nerve.mattemena.com is developed by Matte Nerve. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
